c.tagline: Atlantic island capital of levada walks, wine, and eternal spring.

taxi.fareNote: Taxis are yellow with a blue stripe and run on the meter. Uber does not operate on Madeira; Bolt is available but coverage is thin, so pre-booking a taxi or hotel transfer is common.

emergency.note: 112 is the single EU-wide emergency number connecting to police, fire, and ambulance.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

hood_desc: The walkable centre around Funchal Cathedral (Sé), the Municipal Square, and the harbour promenade, packed with shops, cafes, and the farmers' market (Mercado dos Lavradores); the most convenient base for first-timers.
The historic Zona Velha of narrow cobbled lanes and painted doors, home to the island's densest cluster of restaurants and bars; best for dining out and nightlife.
A modern seafront district west of the centre with the Lido promenade, sea-bathing complexes, and many of Funchal's larger resort hotels; suits travellers who want the sea on their doorstep.

A cool, green hillside above the city reached by the Teleferico cable car, home to the Monte Palace Tropical Garden and the famous wicker toboggan run; quieter, scenic, and a short bus or taxi from the centre.
A residential and hotel area southwest of the centre near Praia Formosa, Funchal's longest beach, and the Casino/Pestana district; calmer and good value, with easy bus links into town.

water.note: Tap water is safe to drink, though some prefer bottled for taste.

transit.hours: City buses run from roughly 6:00 AM to around 11:00 PM, with limited late-night service; the Monte cable car runs daily until about 6:00 PM.
transit.note: Funchal is served by Horários do Funchal city buses (the yellow buses); there is no metro or tram. The Teleferico do Funchal cable car links the seafront to Monte, from where a traditional wicker toboggan (carro de cesto) slides back downhill.
transit.pay: Pay the driver in cash for single tickets, or tap a rechargeable Giro card for cheaper fares; the Giro card is sold at kiosks and the bus company office.

sys.n: Teleférico do Funchal (cable car to Monte)

ferry: Porto Santo Line ferry to Porto Santo island

transit.m: Aerobus / SAM airport bus to Funchal centre (~30-45 min)

tip.r: Service isn't automatically included; rounding up or leaving 5-10% for good service is appreciated but not expected.
